body:
High-impact commands now delegate workflow execution to sub-agents, keeping the parent context minimal (~80-110 lines per command instead of loading 400-1400+ line workflows directly).

Changes:
- execute-plan: Delegates 1,436-line workflow to sub-agent
- plan-phase: Delegates 392-line workflow + references to sub-agent
- create-roadmap: Delegates 481-line workflow to sub-agent
- research-phase: Delegates 416-line workflow to sub-agent
- new-milestone: Delegates 389-line workflow to sub-agent
- complete-milestone: Delegates 643-line workflow to sub-agent
- discuss-phase: Reads workflow on-demand (interactive, stays in main)
- discuss-milestone: Reads workflow on-demand (interactive, stays in main)

Pattern used:
- Remove @workflow.md references (preloads into parent context)
- Add <delegate_execution> section with Task tool instructions
- Sub-agent reads workflow in fresh 200k context
- Parent only receives compact summary

Estimated context reduction: ~88% for workflow-heavy commands (from ~5,900 lines to ~680 lines loaded in parent)

## Summary
- Refactored GPT-CAD to support multiple AI providers through a pluggable architecture
- Added Anthropic Claude as a new AI provider alongside existing OpenAI support
- Improved UI with provider/model selection and better conversation display

## Changes

### New Features
- **Multi-provider support**: Switch between OpenAI and Anthropic Claude from the UI
- **Model selection**: Choose from available models for each provider
- **Persistent configuration**: Settings saved to `~/.gptcad_config.json`
- **Secure API key storage**: Keys stored in `~/.gptcad_keys.json` with restricted permissions
- **Clear history button**: Reset conversation without restarting

### Architecture
- Created `ai_providers/` module with abstract base class pattern
- `AIProvider` base class defines standard interface for all providers
- Easy to extend with new providers (Ollama, Azure, etc.)

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed indentation bug in error handling
- Fixed conversation history not including assistant responses
- Added request timeouts to prevent UI hanging

### Files Added
- `ai_providers/__init__.py` - Provider registry and factory
- `ai_providers/base.py` - Abstract provider interface
- `ai_providers/openai_provider.py` - OpenAI implementation
- `ai_providers/claude_provider.py` - Anthropic Claude implementation
- `config.py` - Configuration management

### Files Modified
- `gpt.py` - Updated UI with provider selection, bug fixes
- `gpt4_integration.py` - Converted to backwards-compatible wrapper
- `_init_.py` - Added package metadata
- `README.md` - Comprehensive documentation update

## Supported Models

| Provider | Models |
|----------|--------|
| OpenAI | GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4, GPT-3.5 Turbo |
| Claude | Claude 4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Claude 3 Opus |

## Test Plan
- [ ] Verify OpenAI provider works with existing API keys
- [ ] Test Claude provider with Anthropic API key
- [ ] Confirm provider switching updates model list
- [ ] Verify settings persist across sessions
- [ ] Test conversation history maintains context
- [ ] Confirm undo functionality still works

body:
This pull request refactors the service fetching and metrics polling logic in the `Home` component of the dashboard app. The main improvements include extracting the service fetching logic into a memoized callback, optimizing metrics polling to avoid stale closures, and cleaning up unused code.

**Refactoring and optimization:**

* Extracted `fetchServices` into a `useCallback` hook to ensure stable references and prevent unnecessary re-renders.
* Refactored the metrics polling logic to use a `useRef` (`servicesRef`) for accessing the latest services state, preventing issues with stale closures and unnecessary interval resets. The polling now updates only the `metrics` property for each service, ensuring more efficient state updates.

**Code cleanup:**

* Removed the old, inline `fetchServices` function definition, as it is now handled by the `useCallback` hook.

**Dependency and import updates:**

* Added `useCallback` and `useRef` to the React imports to support the new hooks used in the refactored logic.

**UI consistency:**

Recent runs showed crashes in newly documented tests (perfect forwarding, RVO edge cases, observable forwarding, varargs). This PR hardens call lowering to preserve reference semantics and improves `__builtin_va_start` handling for pointer-based `va_list` typedefs.

- Reference-aware call lowering
  - Always resolve overload metadata even when a mangled name is precomputed, ensuring parameter reference flags are available.
  - Cache parameter reference/pack info per mangled name; use it when emitting call operands to avoid unintended dereference or value-passing.
  - Apply cached reference info when building typed call arguments so reference parameters remain references end-to-end.

- Variadic startup robustness

## Summary

Adds the SatoshiVault smart contract implementing a Bitcoin-collateralized stablecoin system on Stacks. Users create vaults, lock BTC collateral, mint SATS stablecoins, redeem debt, and are subject to automated liquidation when collateralization thresholds are breached.

## What’s Included

* SIP-010–compatible stablecoin token state
* Vault creation and tracking per user
* BTC price oracle authorization and updates
* Over-collateralized minting with configurable ratios
* Stablecoin redemption and debt reduction
* Automated liquidation for under-collateralized vaults
* Admin-controlled risk parameter updates
* Read-only queries for vaults, supply, and pricing

## Core Rules

* Minting requires minimum collateralization ratio
* Liquidation triggers below threshold ratio
* Per-vault mint limits enforced
* Only vault owners can mint or redeem
* Oracle updates restricted to authorized feeds

## Security Notes

* Explicit vault ownership checks
* Oracle price bounds enforced
* Liquidation removes vault and burns debt
* Parameter changes restricted to contract owner
* Defensive validation on all public entrypoints

## Scope

* Single-asset collateral (BTC)
* No interest rate or yield model
* No governance voting (owner-controlled parameters)
* No cross-vault netting or delegation

body:
1. 데이터베이스 구조

┌─────────────┐         ┌──────────────┐
│   users     │         │   credits    │
├─────────────┤         ├──────────────┤
│ id (PK)     │◄────1:1─┤ user_id (FK) │
│ email       │         │ balance      │
│ name        │         │ version      │ ← Optimistic Locking
└─────────────┘         └──────────────┘
                               │
                               │ 1:N
                               ▼
                        ┌──────────────────┐
                        │ credit_history   │
                        ├──────────────────┤
                        │ user_id (FK)     │
                        │ type             │ (SIGNUP, VTO_USED 등)
                        │ amount           │ (+100, -3)
                        │ balance_before   │
                        │ balance_after    │
                        │ description      │
                        └──────────────────┘
2. 핵심 메커니즘: Optimistic Locking
credit.service.ts에서 구현:

async deductCredit(userId, amount) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    // 1. 현재 크레딧 조회 (version 포함)
    const credit = await tx.credit.findUnique({
      where: { userId }
    });
    // balance: 100, version: 5

    // 2. 버전 체크하면서 업데이트 시도
    const updated = await tx.credit.updateMany({
      where: {
        userId,
        version: 5  // ← 이 버전이 일치해야 업데이트됨
      },
      data: {
        balance: 97,
        version: 6  // ← 버전 증가
      }
    });

    // 3. 다른 요청이 먼저 업데이트했으면 count = 0
    if (updated.count === 0) {
      // 재시도!
      continue;
    }

    // 4. 성공하면 이력 기록
    await tx.creditHistory.create({
      balanceBefore: 100,
      balanceAfter: 97,
      amount: -3
    });
  }
}
3. 동시성 문제 해결 시나리오

시간 →
Request A: [조회: 100, v5] → [업데이트 시도: v5→v6] → ✅ 성공 (97, v6)
Request B: [조회: 100, v5] → [업데이트 시도: v5→v6] → ❌ 실패 (v6로 이미 변경됨)
                                                         ↓
                                      [재조회: 97, v6] → [업데이트: v6→v7] → ✅ 성공 (94, v7)
4. 크레딧 흐름
회원가입 시
user.service.ts:

1. User 레코드 생성
2. Credit 레코드 생성 (balance: 0, version: 0)
3. 100 크레딧 지급 (SIGNUP)
VTO 사용 시
fitting.service.ts:

1. 크레딧 부족 체크
2. 3 크레딧 차감 (Optimistic Locking으로 안전하게)
3. VTO 처리
4. 이력에 기록:
   - balanceBefore: 100
   - amount: -3
   - balanceAfter: 97
   - type: VTO_USED
5. 실제 서비스에서 이렇게 관리하는 이유
✅ 동시성 안전

5개의 VTO 요청이 동시에 들어와도:
- 잘못: 100 → 97 (5번) = 최종 97 (12크레딧 손실!)
- 올바름: 100 → 97 → 94 → 91 → 88 → 85 ✓
✅ 완벽한 감사 추적

SELECT * FROM credit_history WHERE user_id = 'xxx';
-- 언제, 무엇으로, 얼마나 변경됐는지 모두 추적 가능
✅ 복구 가능

-- 특정 시점의 잔액 재계산
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM credit_history
WHERE user_id = 'xxx'
AND created_at <= '2026-01-05 12:00:00';
6. vs 이전 방식 비교
항목	이전 (User.credit)	현재 (Credit 테이블)
동시성 안전	❌ Race Condition 발생	✅ Optimistic Locking
감사 추적	△ 이력만 기록	✅ 전/후 잔액 모두 기록
복구 가능	❌ 어려움	✅ 이력 기반 재계산
데이터 정합성	△ 약함	✅ 강함
7. 주요 API
GET /credit - 현재 잔액 조회 (credit.controller.ts)
GET /credit/history - 거래 이력 조회 (credit.controller.ts)
내부: deductVtoCredit() - VTO 사용 시 3 크레딧 차감 (credit.service.ts)

[CreditService] Optimistic lock conflict on deductCredit (attempt 1/3), retrying...

body:
## feat: Add Microsoft Phi-4 Support

### Summary
This PR enables support for the Microsoft Phi-4 (14B) model on Tenstorrent Wormhole hardware.

### Changes

#### 1. Phi-4 Support (Feature)
- **Model Recognition**: Updated common.py and model_config.py to correctly identify and load microsoft/phi-4.
- **Optimization Strategy**: Added specific configurations for Phi-4 — defaults to BFP8 for WQKV weights to fit within DRAM on N150/N300 devices.
- **Memory Safety**: Set appropriate MAX_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE (4 for N150) to prevent OOM errors, reduced prefill_len_cutoff to 512 for N150/N300.
- **Config Overrides**: Added model_params/phi-4/ with config.json (250k RoPE), params.json, and accuracy_decoder_config.json (decoders 0 and 39 for 40-layer coverage).

#### 2. Safety Improvement
- Replaced assert False with 
aise ValueError for missing HF_MODEL environment variable, ensuring the error is enforced even when Python runs with -O optimization flag.

### Verification
- Phi-4: Validated config loading and parameter ingestion (RoPE theta: 250000.0).
- Existing models: Verified that existing configurations (Llama-3, Phi-3, etc.) are unaffected.

### Files Changed (5)
- \models/tt_transformers/model_params/phi-4/config.json\ (new)
- \models/tt_transformers/model_params/phi-4/params.json\ (new)
- \models/tt_transformers/model_params/phi-4/accuracy_decoder_config.json\ (new)
- \models/tt_transformers/tt/model_config.py\ (modified)
- \models/tt_transformers/tt/common.py\ (modified)
